newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold market trade rises as prices ease.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold market trade rises as prices ease.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange rose slightly to 830 kilos on Wednesday from 720 kilos on Tuesday as lower prices encouraged a slight uplift in physical demand, dealers said.
Gold closed lower at $353.30 an ounce and 1,422,500 lira per gram from $355.00 and 1,424,000 on Tuesday in line with the trends on European markets.
The Turkish lira eased sligthly to 125,000 lira to the dollar, from Tuesday's 124,820.
The bulk of the day's trade -- 535 kilos -- took place in the morning session, with 81.9 percent of the total trade conducted in lira terms.
